complete_when.text: C1: Release tooling and release notes prepared and verified with make test-release-tools
C2: Release cut, tag pushed atomically to origin, and make watch-release started

constraints: Owner explicitly authorized self-approving the release notes ('aprova por si o texto do release')
Include .task-memory/ snapshot in every commit via git add -f -A .task-memory
Use make watch-release (detached, no agent polling)
contract.delivery_boundary: Release tag pushed atomically to origin, make watch-release started, hey notification sent
expected_results: Curated release notes and CHANGELOG.md entry for the new stable v2 release
Release tooling and workflow supporting v2.X.Y stable tags cleanly
Atomic push of main and the release tag, make watch-release started, and Task Memory completed
contract.objective: Prepare and cut the next stable CodeWalk 2 release on main (v2.1.0 for the new composer & timeline attachments feature) with self-approved release notes, push the release commit and tag atomically, and start make watch-release.
scope_in: Inspect release tooling (tool/release/, Makefile, .github/workflows/release.yml) and upgrade stable release scripts if needed to support post-2.0.0 stable releases (v2.X.Y)
Draft curated release notes with one leading > 📣 announcement line (<=300 chars) covering composer and timeline attachments (#473)
Verify release tooling tests (make test-release-tools), commit release notes/tooling if updated, cut the stable release atomically, and run make watch-release
scope_out: Polling CI/Release in an agent loop (use detached make watch-release per CodeWalk AGENTS.md)

next_action: Commit release notes and tooling, push main, run make release V=stable, and start make watch-release
title: Cut and publish the next stable v2 release with self-approved release notes
